title: Krrsantan
subtitle: Bounty Hunter
description: Krrsantan was an immense, black-furred Wookiee who took on jobs of enforcement and bounty hunting. Known for his ferocity, Krrsantan was hired by the Twins to hunt down and eliminate Boba Fett. When Krrsantan failed, Fett hired him onto his crew, giving the ill-tempered Wookiee a new purpose and lease on life.
